# Champion Quest: Complete-Campaign Preview

Expanded from four gyms and 20 species to all eight gyms, the Elite Four,
Champion, Hall of Fame, postgame areas, and acquisition paths for all 151 species.

- 64 campaign areas plus title and battle scenes.
- New regional encounters, trainer teams, story objectives, legendary encounters,
  evolution, local trade evolution, shops, Fly travel, and Master Ball.
- Updated color maps and 151 front/back sprite pairs.
- 56 authored-event tests plus navigation, sprite, resource, and memory checks.

This is a condensed custom fan game, not the original Red/Blue ROM or an exact
implementation of its battle engine. Runtime gameplay and physical Chromatic
play remain unverified. Treat this as a preview build, not a fully playtested release.

**Start a new game. Back up old saves; v0.3.0 changes the save memory layout.**

Extract the ZIP and open Pokemon-Kanto.gbc in a GBC emulator. The Windows
installation assistant verifies the checksum and opens the included Chromatic
guide; it does not write or erase a cartridge. See release.json for build evidence.
